treatment: The generated architecture and portrait city are independent layers. Transparent CSS window masks reveal the native phone city without enlarging the city bitmap. Existing figures and door cutouts remain independent.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: portrait 4:5 empty architectural backplate for a premium reality-TV mobile-game cinematic.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing Hub departure vestibule. Image 2 is a CITY AND MATERIAL REFERENCE.
Add a sophisticated tall city-view window to the LEFT wall of image 1, so a camera can turn toward it after the departure doors close. Its clear rectangular glass opening must occupy approximately x=5% to x=35%, y=11% to y=59% of the frame. Slim champagne-bronze framing, believable smoked-walnut reveals, realistic night glazing, with the same warm, detailed New York-like river skyline and city lights as image 2. The view is from inside the same expensive contemporary television residence.
Remove the existing large potted plant on the left so no leaves overlap this window opening. Keep the left-side practical lighting tasteful and physically plausible.
CRITICAL invariants: preserve the entire RIGHT-side open double-door exit and its front-facing geometry, surrounding frame, exterior covered walkway, lighting and distant landscape. The doorway opening must stay at x=44.8% to x=90.8%, y=10% to y=66%, with the level threshold at 66%. Keep the overall camera, floor perspective, empty foreground floor, warm smoked walnut/brass/stone materials and 4:5 composition unchanged. No door leaves: separate door cutouts will be composited later.
Style: restrained prestige reality-TV architectural photography, real tactile materials, quiet warm practical lighting, sophisticated atmosphere. No people, silhouettes, suitcases, chairs, text, logos, watermarks, UI, magic, neon or particles. One complete coherent backplate.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: high-detail full-screen city plate for a premium reality-TV PORTRAIT MOBILE GAME cinematic.
Image 1 is a city, architecture and night-lighting REFERENCE, not a layout to crop or enlarge.
Create a fresh, sharply detailed photographic city view in a TALL PHONE COMPOSITION, aspect ratio 6:13 (approximately 1080 x 2340 pixels), at the highest native detail available. The entire frame is the outside view, with no interior or window frame.
Show the same believable New York-like river metropolis at night: a beautiful layered skyline, bridges over the river, warm office windows, detailed masonry and glass buildings, rich distant street lights and restrained river reflections. Preserve the reference's sophisticated natural photography, warm champagne lights and dark blue night. Compose specifically for a tall phone rather than stretching a landscape image. Dark sky should occupy only the top quarter; architectural detail and the luminous river fill the lower three quarters. Natural atmospheric depth, crisp fine building edges and individual windows, controlled highlights, realistic subdued contrast.
This is the final held movie frame, so central details must read clearly on a portrait phone. It will be shown directly, without digital zoom or enlargement. No room, floor, sill, curtains, foreground furniture, people, silhouettes, text, logos, UI, watermarks, neon, magical lights, particles or artificial star effects. Do not return a blurry crop or a softened upscale.

intermediateReferences.purpose: City reference used to generate the taller final phone plate; not bundled as a runtime asset.
intermediateReferences.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: crisp full-bleed portrait 4:5 night-city plate for the final close-up of a premium reality-TV mobile-game cinematic.
Image 1 is the CITY REFERENCE / EDIT TARGET. Reframe the city outside this window into a complete unobstructed portrait city view. Preserve its believable New York-like river skyline, layered warm office lights, bridges, night sky, time of night, warm champagne light and restrained photographic color treatment.
The resulting entire image must be the city and sky only: no room, floor, window frame, sill, curtains, reflections of people, furniture or foreground architecture. Use the full frame for the distant city. Dark atmospheric sky occupies roughly the top quarter; the lower three quarters show rich real architectural detail, river reflections, warm illuminated windows, layered towers, and fine street-light ribbons. Crisp natural photographic detail, convincing atmospheric depth, controlled exposure, no oversharpening or exaggerated glow.
This view will also be seen through a narrow separately composited bronze window and enlarged to fill a portrait phone. Keep the most elegant river skyline and dense lights toward the center. No text, logos, UI, watermarks, people, particles, stars added as effects, fireworks, neon, flat vector shapes or cartoon rendering.
